title: 3 Bed · 3.5 Bath 2-Story Modern Residence
designer_rationale: While all schemes score equally on circulation, privacy, and daylight, the Vastu Shastra Harmonic Scheme delivers the highest Vastu compliance (85.9) and aligns the master bedroom (SW) and kitchen (SE) correctly. Its orientation-aware zoning also places the puja/living areas toward the Northeast/East, satisfying the most critical Vastu directives. The only remaining conflict is the entry foyer in the Southwest, which is less disruptive than a living‑room misplacement and can be remedied with a modest re‑layout. Site-first planning with South frontage, 5.0ft front setback, and 3 bedrooms across 1541.2 sq ft.

rule_results.explanation: Staircase Landing placed in auspicious Southwest zone. Heavy vertical load-bearing stairs belong in South or West; strictly avoid Ishanya (Northeast) and Brahmasthan (Center).
Family Gallery located in neutral Center zone (ideal is South / West / Northwest).
Primary Suite located in neutral Center zone (ideal is Southwest).
Primary Bath placed in auspicious West zone. Wet zones and drainage in West/Northwest keep toxins away from the sacred Northeast (Ishanya) and center.
Bedroom 2 located in neutral Northwest zone (ideal is Southwest).
Upper Bath placed in auspicious Northwest zone. Wet zones and drainage in West/Northwest keep toxins away from the sacred Northeast (Ishanya) and center.

recommendations: Layout harmoniously balances core Vastu quadrants with architectural flow.

strengths: Master bedroom correctly positioned in Southwest for stability.
Kitchen in Southeast, honoring Agni zone.
Puja/Living spaces oriented toward Northeast/East, enhancing positive energy.
Efficient central circulation spine with clear public‑private separation.
weaknesses: Entry foyer located in Southwest, a Vastu violation.
Vastu score, while highest among candidates, is still below the ideal 100.
No explicit acoustic buffer for the entry area.
suggestions: Relocate the entry foyer to the North or East façade to meet Vastu recommendations.
Introduce a modest vestibule or screened porch to buffer the foyer from the interior.
Consider a secondary secondary entrance on the North side for guests, preserving the primary entrance's Vastu integrity.
